Customer User Journey

The H2O Online customer app helps you order drinking water, manage subscriptions, track deliveries, log hydration, and manage your account — all from one mobile app.

1. Discover & Join

New users choose the Customer role, create a profile or sign in, and recover access if needed.

  • Welcome & Role Selection
  • Create Your Profile
  • Customer Login
  • OTP Login
  • Forgot Password

2. Home & Daily Use

The dashboard is your daily hub — hydration stats, wallet, subscriptions, quick ordering, and AI health insights.

  • Home Dashboard

3. Order Water

Browse products, add to cart, pay, confirm, track live delivery, and revisit past orders.

  • Browse & Order Water
  • Shopping Cart
  • Checkout
  • Payment
  • Order Confirmed
  • Track Your Order
  • Order History

4. Subscriptions & Billing

Set up recurring water delivery plans and pay monthly bills from your wallet.

  • Water Subscription Plans
  • Subscription Billing

5. Stay Hydrated

Log daily intake, track goals, and get personalised hydration guidance.

  • Water Intake Tracker

6. Manage Account

Update personal details, addresses, payment methods, and account security.

  • Saved Addresses
  • My Profile

7. Get Help

Raise support tickets, follow up on issues, and review how your data is protected.

  • Help & Support
  • Privacy Policy

Getting Started Step 1 of 20

Welcome & Role Selection

Features

Animated splash screen introducing the H2O Online brand. Choose how you want to use the app: Customer (order water for home), Partner (water supplier), or preview upcoming roles like Corporate, Restaurant, and Institute. Sign up as a new customer or log in to an existing account.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Getting Started Step 2 of 20

Create Your Profile

Features

Complete customer registration with name, email, phone, password, age, gender, and activity level. Set a daily hydration goal, upload a profile photo, and pick a starter plan (Basic, Family, Active, or Premium). Accept terms and conditions to activate your account.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Getting Started Step 3 of 20

Customer Login

Features

Sign in with email and password. Accept terms before logging in. Links to forgot password, OTP login, and new customer sign-up. After login you land on your personal dashboard.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Getting Started Step 4 of 20

OTP Login

Features

Alternative sign-in using a one-time password sent to your registered phone or email. Enter the 6-digit code to access your account without a password.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Getting Started Step 5 of 20

Forgot Password

Features

Recover access when you forget your password. Enter your registered email to receive reset instructions. Option to return to standard login or OTP login.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Daily Hub Step 6 of 20

Home Dashboard

Features

Personalised greeting with your name and profile photo. View wallet balance and loyalty points at a glance. Quick actions: Order Jar, My Plan, Track Delivery, Wallet, Water Intake, and Billing. See ongoing order banner with live status. Weekly hydration graph and today's goal progress. Active subscription selector. Water AI Sense insights with expandable tips, health report, and ask-a-question. Connected devices section (Apple Watch, Smart Bottle, TV Hub).

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Ordering Step 7 of 20

Browse & Order Water

Features

Browse the full water product catalog in a visual grid. Filter by All, Price, Fastest Delivery, Top Rated, or Nearest Supplier. Filter by size ranges from 1–5 L up to 20+ L. Options for bulk orders (500+ L) and tanker delivery. Use-case filters for parties and office orders. View star ratings and customer reviews. Compare products side by side. Add items to cart or buy instantly. Access saved delivery addresses from the header.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Ordering Step 8 of 20

Shopping Cart

Features

Review all items added to your cart with product images and supplier names. Increase or decrease quantities with +/− controls. Remove unwanted items. See line totals and cart subtotal. Continue shopping or proceed to checkout.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Ordering Step 9 of 20

Checkout

Features

Confirm delivery address manually or pick from saved addresses. Choose instant delivery or schedule for a later date and time. Order for someone else with receiver name and phone. Apply coupon codes for discounts. Review complete order summary. Quick access to wallet top-up.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Ordering Step 10 of 20

Payment

Features

Choose how to pay: H2 Wallet balance, UPI, Credit/Debit Card, or Cash on Delivery. View final order summary with itemised costs. Confirm and place your order securely.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Order Confirmed

Features

Success confirmation with your order ID. Clear message that your order has been placed. Buttons to track your delivery in real time or return to the home dashboard.

Ordering Step 12 of 20

Track Your Order

Features

Live delivery timeline showing each stage: Order Accepted → Picked Up → Out for Delivery → Delivered. Estimated time of arrival. Supplier and delivery partner details. One-tap call driver button. Order items and delivery address summary.

Ordering Step 13 of 20

Order History

Features

Complete list of past and current orders with status badges. Filter by order status. View product details for each order. Rate and review delivered products. Reorder or shop again with one tap.

Account & Addresses Step 14 of 20

Saved Addresses

Features

Manage home, office, and other delivery locations. Add new addresses with house number, locality, city, state, PIN code, and contact phone. Edit or delete existing addresses. Set a default address for faster checkout and subscription deliveries.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Subscriptions Step 15 of 20

Water Subscription Plans

Features

Choose a subscription plan: Basic, Family, Active, or Premium — each with different jar sizes and delivery frequency. Set delivery frequency (daily, weekly, or monthly). Pick preferred delivery time window. Select products included in your plan. Add delivery address and locality. Create, update, or pause active subscriptions.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Subscriptions Step 16 of 20

Subscription Billing

Features

View all monthly subscription bills in one place. Filter by All, Pending, Paid, or Overdue. See bill amount, billing period, and due date. Pay pending bills directly from your H2 Wallet. Status badges show payment state at a glance.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Health & Hydration Step 17 of 20

Water Intake Tracker

Features

Log daily water intake by glass, jar, bottle, or custom volume. Track progress toward your personal daily hydration goal. View a 7-day consumption graph. Water AI Sense banner with personalised hydration tips. Suggested intake based on your profile and activity level.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Account & Settings Step 18 of 20

My Profile

Features

Profile header with photo, name, and member stats (total orders, loyalty points, wallet balance). Quick links to My Plan, Saved Addresses, and Order History. Account section: edit personal information (name, email, phone), manage payment methods (cards, UPI, wallet), change password, and view order history. Support section: Help & Support tickets and Privacy Policy. Secure logout.

Full-scroll capture — entire screen content shown above

Support Step 19 of 20

Help & Support

Features

View all your support tickets with status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed). Create a new ticket by choosing a category: Order Issue, Delivery Problem, Payment/Billing, Account & Login, Product Quality, or Other. Add subject and detailed description. Follow ticket conversation thread and add replies. Pull to refresh ticket list.

Support Step 20 of 20

Privacy Policy

Features

Clear explanation of how H2O Online collects, uses, and protects your personal data. Sections covering data collection, usage purposes, third-party sharing, security measures, data retention, your rights, children's privacy, and contact information for privacy enquiries.
